comparison.objective: Clamp a glue-up with a two-screw wooden handscrew while keeping its jaws flat.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinate two spatially separate screws to regulate jaw parallelism.
comparison.success_condition: The boards remain clamped with the jaws bearing flat along the joint.
comparison.reason: This is a plausible neighbor in coupled adjustment, but it balances two clamp openings rather than counterholding one setting while a concentric jam nut locks it and then cycle-testing the mechanism.
